parameters.name: ErroredSecs
parameters.description: Total number of errored {{units}} as defined in ITU-T Rec. {{bibref|G.997.2}}. An errored second (ES) is declared if, during a 1-second interval, there are one or more crc anomalies, or one or more los defects, or one or more lor defects, or one or more lpr primitives.

parameters.name: SeverelyErroredSecs
parameters.description: Total number of severely errored {{units}} as defined in ITU-T Rec. {{bibref|G.997.2}}.

parameters.name: LOSS
parameters.description: Total number of loss of signal {{units}} (LOSS) as defined in ITU-T Rec. {{bibref|G.997.2}}. A LOSS is declared if, during a 1-second interval, there are one or more los defects.

parameters.name: LORS
parameters.description: Total number of loss of RMC {{units}} (LORS) as defined in ITU-T Rec. {{bibref|G.997.2}}. A LORS is declared if, during a 1-second interval, there are one or more lor defects.

parameters.name: UAS
parameters.description: Total number of unavailable {{units}} (UAS) as defined in ITU-T Rec. {{bibref|G.997.2}}.

parameters.name: RTXUC
parameters.description: This parameter reports a count of uncorrected DTU anomalies (rtx_uc). This parameter is defined in clause 7.8.5 of ITU-T Rec. {{bibref|G.997.2}}.

parameters.name: RTXTX
parameters.description: This parameter reports a count of retransmitted DTU anomalies (rtx_tx). This parameter is defined in clause 7.8.6 of ITU-T Rec. {{bibref|G.997.2}}.

parameters.name: SuccessBSW
parameters.description: This parameter reports a count of the successful bit swap (BSW) primitives. This parameter is defined as success_BSW in clause 7.7.20 of ITU-T Rec. {{bibref|G.997.2}}.

parameters.name: SuccessSRA
parameters.description: This parameter reports a count of the successful autonomous SRA (seamless rate adaptation) primitives. This parameter is defined as success_SRA in clause 7.7.21 of ITU-T Rec. {{bibref|G.997.2}}.

parameters.name: SuccessFRA
parameters.description: This parameter reports a count of the successful FRA (fast rate adaptation) primitives. This parameter is defined as success_FRA in clause 7.7.22 of ITU-T Rec. {{bibref|G.997.2}}.

parameters.name: SuccessRPA
parameters.description: This parameter reports a count of the successful RPA (RMC parameter adjustment) primitives. This parameter is defined as success_RPA in clause 7.7.23 of ITU-T Rec. {{bibref|G.997.2}}.

parameters.name: SuccessTIGA
parameters.description: This parameter reports a count of the successful TIGA (transmitter initiated gain adjustment) primitives. This parameter is defined as success_TIGA in clause 7.7.24 of ITU-T Rec. {{bibref|G.997.2}}.

object.description: This object contains FAST line statistics since the second most recent showtime. Note: The Total parameters SHOULD NOT be reset when the interface statistics are reset via an interface disable / enable cycle.
